---
title: "Where is the neutral point with the wings at the rear?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 7.8      # s the probe actually used

plane = get_airplane()
op = asb.OperatingPoint(velocity=5, alpha=0)
aero = asb.AeroBuildup(airplane=plane, op_point=op).run_with_stability_derivatives(alpha=True)

x_np = aero['x_np'][0]
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{x_np:.3f} m"`]{.hero-value}
[from the nose]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The neutral point moves back to [`{python} f"{x_np:.3f} m"`]{.key} when the wings are placed at the rear of the fuselage.
